## Problem or use case

What problem would this solve, or what workflow would it improve? (e.g. controller behavior, webhook, WebSocket, CRD, or operator integration.)

## Proposed solution

Describe the feature or change you'd like (e.g. new validation rule, new status field, Helm option).

## Alternatives considered

Any other approaches you thought about.

## Additional context

Examples, mockups, or references to similar behavior in other operators or tools.
